notes.title: Crashing Bugfix
notes.notes: Just released a patch to hopefully address some of the crashing people have been experiencing. Not sure if it will eliminate it entirely but should hopefully mitigate it from happening as frequently.

notes.title: Patch 1.5.1
notes.notes:
Some of these changes have already been implemented, but I'm going to condense them all here. We have more bugfixes & balance changes on the way, but here is a comprehensive list of what has changed so far. Patch notes contain spoilers for 1.5.

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

[list]
[*] The piano demon will no longer follow you out of rooms
[*] Pressing S while holding wine now works as intended
[*] You can now speak to dad while he is squirming
[*] Playing Grandma’s song will now summon her if you play it before 2AM
[*] Adjusted the Piano Demon speed
[*] Adjusted the Lady Spirit speed
[*] Talking to The Seamstress has been streamlined
[*] Adjusted the "Family" ending visuals
[*] Adjusted the "Memories" ending visuals
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the cat not to spawn in the tv scene, despite being saved
[*] Fixed some sound mixing issues
[*] Fixed an issue that allowed players to change the channel after selecting  Tabby/Melody channels on TV
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the doll to disappear when picked up
[*] Fixed an issue that caused mom’s chat box interface to not appear
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the “toggle fullscreen” button not to work
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the achievement “Hey Girl,” to not unlock
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the tv scene to stop taking inputs
[*] Fixed an issue where loading Tabby’s loop from the TV scene would cause the lights in the hallway to remain off
[*] Fixed an issue where if you died in Tabby's loop you would restart as Melody
[/list]


[h1]Known Issues[/h1]

[list]
[*] Crashing upon dying / randomly crashing in Melody's loop
[*] Long load times on startup
[/list]

We are still working on optimizing the new content and hope to get everything as smooth as possible for y'all. Thanks again so much for playing.

notes.title: Patch 1.5 "Melodies"
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38928212/9ddff03aa80f1ca31d9551fa21dbcf02ab9b6f23.png[/img]

[h1]Time to go home...[/h1]

[i]Several months have passed since Tabby broke free, and Melody has woken up into a rotting house abandoned by time. The fabric of reality twisting around her as a mysterious entity arrives to seal her fate.  [/i]

[list]
[*] Tabby’s depressed sister, Melody is now playable
[*] Explore a twisted version of the house
[*] Play songs to reshape fate
[*] Die in all new gruesome ways
[*] Groove to a brand new soundtrack
[*] + more to come! 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38928212/6810ee19b8fb6289b9d9d7db943d38663f0a213c.png[/img]

[b] Known issues [/b]
Due to the size and increase in scope of this update we've had a few memory-related issues causing the game to crash at times. We have been working hard to optimize it as best as we can and please ask patience while we sort it out. 

Be sure to check out the HOUSE [url=https://discord.gg/aMyKThwCMR]Discord server[/url]! It's the best place to get into contact with us or post bugs. 

Here is the soundtrack! Available now on [url=https://isacknight.bandcamp.com/album/melodies]Bandcamp![/url] [previewyoutube=9FyMop3ecM8;full][/previewyoutube]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38928212/0867400421f798bebaa0de4c54629b45c4b33268.png[/img]


Thanks everyone again for playing HOUSE! We hope you enjoy this next chapter and thank you for being so patient while we worked on it. It's been over a year since the game came out and we've had 4 major free content updates since then. With 1.5 and previous updates we have essentially quadrupled the amount of content in HOUSE. We will be increasing the price to 9.99 Feb 1st. If you have yet to get the game and have it on your wishlist, you still have time to get it at its original and current price of 4.99! 


We have another patch planned for some bugfixes and tidying up stuff on the way, but in the meantime, please do post any bugs you find and we will do our best to fix them! Thank you all again so much, and please stay tuned for what's next.

notes.title: Patch 1.4.3
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38928212/a5dab33b15c8b908d81aae90660c6f7abf2b0473.png[/img]

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

[list]
[*] The Frog Lord no longer teabags your corpse
[*] Fixed an issue where saying no to Marty and then talking to Dolly would cause the game to lock up
[*] Adjusted the length of Frog Lord stun to 1.5 seconds from 1.0 seconds.
[*] Adjusted giggling
[*] The Centipede wiggle sound now pauses if you are in conversation
[*] Fixed multiple sound-related issues
[*] Killing Melody while sitting now plays the correct facing animation
[*] Added additional dialog for Marty
[*] Fixed some visual inconsistencies 
[*] Fixed an issue that caused some characters and UI to appear mirrored
[*] Fixed an issue that disabled the ability to pick up the rubber ducky when time is frozen
[*] Fixed an issue the caused mom to get frozen after placing sandwiches on the table
[*] The slingshot no longer collides with certain objects
[*] The Seamstress now slips on water
[*] The time for Seamstress tripping has been decreased
[*] Frog Lord now appears closer to the door he spawns into
[*] Fixed an issue where the slingshot would collide with empty space
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.4.2
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38928212/a5dab33b15c8b908d81aae90660c6f7abf2b0473.png[/img]

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

[list]
[*] The rat now falls asleep at 11 pm
[*] Using the key now consumes it on use
[*] The mouth now eats any item that is over it
[/list]

[h2]Bugfixes & Balance Changes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the game to soft lock when killing and talking to an npc at the same time
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the game to freeze when smashing the clock just as the sandwich cutscene plays
[*] Fixed an issue that allowed Tabby to talk to NPCs while dead
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the “Talk” interface to remain on screen in the abyss
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the game to crash during the true ending cutscene (hopefully!)
[*] Mom now slips on all liquids when carrying sandwiches
[*] Adjusted hitboxes for giant fingers
[*] Shotgun now works for killing fingers
[*] The rat no longer moonwalks
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the rat to not walk back to the center of the room if he is berserk
[*] Fixed an issue that caused new save files to start with an ending unlocked
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the game to soft lock if you die at the same time as a dialogue event occurs
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the slingshot to sometimes not kill shadow men
[*] Shotgun can now destroy the clock
[*] Fixed an issue that caused leaving and re-enterring the piano room to spawn fingers more frequently
[*] The spike rug will now only switch to kill mode if Tabby is not in the room
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the game to soft lock if possessed mom steps on the bear trap while carrying Tabby
[*] Monsters no longer try to pick up Tabby if she is killed by another threat
[*] Fixed an issue the caused the game to soft lock if the player speaks to an npc at the same time that mom calls for sandwiches
[*] The neighbor no longer tells you to cleanse the curse after achieving the "Memories" ending
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the camera to appear too far out of bounds in certain situations involving the “Family” ending
[*] Decreased the amount of time it takes for the Seamstress to trip after being alerted
[*] Dropping bowling ball on corpses causes them to bounce
[/list]

UPDATE 

[list]
[*]Fixed an issue causing the game to load their save data from a different folder.]
[*]Adjusted atlases to improve memory usage (this should fix some crashing issues)
[*]Fixed an issue that caused the game to soft lock when the frog lord appears
[*]Fixed an issue that caused Daddy to play the wrong animation when killing Tabby
[/list]

Update 8/17/2021

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that caused some characters and UI to appear mirrored
[*] Fixed an issue that disabled the ability to pick up the rubber ducky when time is frozen
[*] Fixed an issue the caused mom to get frozen after placing sandwiches on the table
[*] The slingshot no longer collides with the mouth
[*] The Seamstress now slips on water
[*] The time for Seamstress tripping has been decreased
[*] Frog Lord no longer appears closer to the door he spawns into
[*] Additional sounds have been added for colliding with the slingshot
[*] Fixed some sound mixing issues
[/list]

UPDATE 

7/14/21 

[list]

notes.title: 1.3 Changes
notes.notes:
[b]BUGFIXES[/b]
The rat will now behave normally after using the bear trap
Mom will no longer break if you speak to her while she's delivering sandwiches
Speaking to your sister during certain events no longer breaks things
Fixed a layering issue with blood near the toilet
Mom is no longer blurry when delivering sandwiches.
Mom now gets drunk for longer

[b]OTHER CHANGES[/b]
Added additional dialog

[b]KNOWN ISSUES[/b]
If you experience lag after destroying the clock open up the menu and under options set your graphics setting to either low or medium. 

[b]COMING SOON[/b]
Achievements
Windowed mode (hopefully!) 
Optimizing the phantom world
More secrets
